retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic 1960s-style layout featuring studio-lit subjects in a staggered diagonal arrangement with bold, angled sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: retro cyan and magenta color block

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, asymmetrical composition characterized by a light blue background, three female subjects in staggered heights wearing matching cyan dresses, and bold text elements oriented at 45-degree angles to create a sense of upward motion and energy.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects staggered from bottom-left to center-right in increasing scale
Primary typography follows the diagonal axis of the subjects' movement
High-contrast color pairing of cyan dresses against a pale blue field
Magenta accents in typography providing a warm counterpoint to the cool palette
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned in the lower two-thirds, scaling up from left to right, creating a diagonal line of sight.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest figure on the right, whose head reaches the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the bottom-left subject, follows the diagonal line of heads to the right, then moves up the magenta text on the right and down the blue text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the top third and between the text blocks to allow for breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale sky blue background providing a clean, airy field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Turquoise for the subjects' clothing and primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta for secondary display text and small graphical elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with high-saturation, medium-value subjects and text.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weights for display text
Uniform stroke width in primary titles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a closed counter and short tail
Exclamation point with a large, circular dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavyweight Grotesque for impact paired with a lighter Geometric Sans for secondary information, both sharing a 45-degree tilt.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and terminal style of the primary display text.
Provides the geometric clarity needed for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a pale sky blue background. Place three female subjects in 1960s cyan cocktail dresses and beehive hairstyles, staggered from bottom-left to center-right, increasing in scale. Use high-key studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold sans-serif text at a 45-degree angle. Use magenta for the top-right display text and cyan for the central display text. Add a list of secondary text in black, also at a 45-degree angle, aligned to the left of the central text.

verificationChecks: Is the text tilted at exactly 45 degrees?
Are the subjects staggered in height from left to right?
Is the color palette limited to cyan, magenta, and pale blue?
Is the typography a heavy sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the staggered line
Saturation of the cyan and magenta accents
Density of the secondary text list
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the subjects' faces.
Verify the 'Stereo' banner is centered at the top.
Check that the magenta and cyan colors are punchy and distinct.
Confirm the composition feels dynamic and upward-moving.
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered Subjects + 45-Degree Sans-Serif Type + Cyan/Magenta/Pale Blue Palette = Mid-Century Dynamic Soul Aesthetic
